title: Onboard Systems receives U.S. Army airworthiness release 2531 for UH-60 Black Hawk cargo hook system
summary: The AWR authorizes military use of the cargo hook on U.S. Army Black Hawks as a direct replacement for existing installations.
body_markdown:
Onboard Systems, a Signia Aerospace company, announced today that it has received a U.S. Army Airworthiness Release (AWR) 2531 **,** for its next-generation Black Hawk cargo hook.


The AWR authorizes military use of the cargo hook on U.S. Army Black Hawks as a direct replacement for existing installations, requiring no changes to aircraft electrical wiring or structural mounts (no MWO required).


The AWR applies to UH-60A/L/M/V and HH-60L/M platforms with legacy cargo hook systems currently installed.


By resolving key maintenance and operational challenges of legacy Black Hawk systems, the TALON MC Black Hawk Cargo Hook improves safety, increases training capabilities, and slashes cargo-hook downtime.


**Elimination of Explosive CAD Components**


The next-generation cargo hook replaces the time-limited Cartridge Actuated Device (CAD) explosive components used for emergency release.


On legacy systems, accidental CAD detonation or emergency deployment leaves military crews unable to perform external load missions. They’re forced to wait on maintenance teams and explosive-certified supply chains to get back in the air.


By removing the CAD components from the legacy hook, Onboard Systems eliminates the accidental explosion risk & maintenance downtime to keep the aircraft mission-ready in the world’s most remote environments.


**Safety and Operational Features**


In addition to the CAD-free emergency release, the Talon MC Black Hawk Cargo Hook includes several modernized operational benefits:


- Keeperless Design: Eliminates the chance of dynamic roll out.
- Dual-Action Manual Release: Designed to reduce inadvertent manual release while allowing intentional release when needed.
- Visual Hook Lock Indicator: Provides a direct visual reference to verify the hook is locked.
- 2.5x Rated Load Release Authority
- Emergency Procedure Training: Allows practice of emergency release procedures without using single-use explosive cartridges.
- Fully compatible with US Army 25,000-pound sling sets with no need for removal of the apex fitting spacer, as noted in TM 4-48.09, Page 2-12.


**Maintenance & Integration**


The newly certified TALON MC Black Hawk Cargo Hook is a drop-in replacement for the legacy cargo hook requiring zero changes to the electrical wiring or structural mounts and no MWO to install.


To simplify field service, the hook features a line-replaceable electrical harnesses and allows unit-level servicing, enabling maintainers to inspect and repair the unit without returning it to the factory.


“As a retired UH-60 crew chief, I am excited to be part of this program. I know how important this is to our National Guard partners who help provide firefighting and domestic response to the Homeland in times of immediate need,” said Jason Stokes, manager of military business development at Onboard Systems.


“The Army’s approval of the AWR allows us to deliver this modernized capability to our military operators to increase operational readiness and ensure mission success.”


The Onboard Systems TALON MC Black Hawk Cargo Hook is authorized under the AWR 2531and is available for military fleet installations and sustainment programs.
